TicketEntry.title: Ticket Entry
TicketEntry.description: An entry in the lottery representing a user's ticket purchase

payoutAddress.description: The user's address for receiving prizes

depositAddress.description: The ephemeral wallet address used for the user's deposit

currency.description: The currency of the deposit (SOL, ETH, BTC, USDT)

usdValue.description: The USD value of the deposit at transaction time

tickets.description: The number of tickets awarded for the deposit

timestamp.description: The ISO timestamp of when the entry was created

txHash.description: The transaction hash of the sweep or transaction identifier
